fields.System.Title: INV-301 — Move stock between locations
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want one service method that moves stock, so that every module
changes inventory through the same correct path instead of writing its own.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given stock at a source location, when I move a quantity to a destination, then
  • the source balance decreases, the destination increases, and a movement is written — all in
  • one transaction.
  • - Given the transaction fails at any point, then no balance changed and no movement
  • exists.
  • - Given a move, then balances are updated as deltas in a single statement, never as
  • read-then-write.
  • - Given a move of a batch-tracked product, then the batch travels with it.
  • - Given any module other than inventory, then it cannot write a balance directly.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance, stock_movement |
| Risks | Lost update ([doc 09 §4.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); partial commit ([doc 09 §2.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · concurrency · rollback · invariant |
